caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate teapot positioned centrally on a plain background. The teapot has a wide, rounded body that narrows toward the base, which is circular and slightly raised. The handle on the left side is large and curved, with intricate scrollwork and decorative elements. The spout on the right side is elongated, sweeping upward with additional ornamental detailing near the base and tip. The lid is domed, topped with a small, round finial resembling a flower or shell. The shading on the teapot gives it a metallic, reflective appearance, predominantly in shades of grey and black. The background is a light, neutral beige tone, and no other objects or additional details are present. The composition is balanced with the teapot occupying most of the visual space, and the lines and texture emphasize the reflective quality of the metal surface.
title: Pewter Teapot
